review_notes: Compared against the previously qualified 1.34.0 release, not an unreleased reference checkout.
The 1.35.1 live node uses its digest-verified official shim, libraries, templates and rootfs. Source hash equality is recorded per file/region; live proofs remain independently required.
Shim engine and task code are byte-identical to 1.34.0. Service startup now installs VmReaper and its containerd-shim configuration; cleanup/lifecycle must be observed under that reaper.
Agent pod changes only expose two existing process helpers as pub(crate). VM resource policy additions do not alter the pinned two-CPU/1024-MiB CRI allocation; live probes verify the guest geometry.
